name: @dispatch-hq/desktop
description: Dispatch HQ — desktop app (Electron) for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Bundles the full game client; accounts, saves, and multiplayer run on the production server. Native (electron-updater) + server-version update channels.
author: De'Andrew Harris

scripts.package: npm run build:web && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:web && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.package:win: npm run build:web && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:web && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
